summary: Completed comprehensive frontend UI testing for LAPORAN STOK SCA portal. Tested login flows (positive & negative), role-based access control (Superadmin vs Admin/PIC), all navigation menus, theme/language toggles, PO CRUD, and HPP calculator. 23/24 test scenarios passed. Backend was already 100% verified in iteration 2.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Kalkulator HPP' link in sidebar doesn't navigate to /hpp (stays on /stok). However, direct URL access to /hpp works perfectly.
ui_bugs.workaround: Users can access HPP via direct URL or browser navigation
ui_bugs.note: Route configuration is correct, NavLink may have binding issue
